verdict.rationale: Mistral's own docs say Voxtral models accept audio input for chat and transcription, and a model card calls Mistral Large 3 a multimodal model. Community hands-on reports confirm the OCR product converts PDFs to markdown, so document input exists, though its accuracy is mixed. Image input is only implied by the 'multimodal' label, and a user notes the OCR endpoint docs lack detail, so coverage across the three input types is uneven. missing for 10: first-party docs showing how to send images in chat requests, documented document/PDF input via the API (OCR endpoint details), and a per-model matrix of which models accept which input types.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input

citations.quote: Voxtral models enable chat and transcription via audio input with various file-passing methods
Open-weight, general-purpose, flagship multimodal and multilingual model
Mistral OCR is super fast and significantly more accurate than Google, Claude and others for PDF to markdown conversion
